title: One debt item: from noticed to paid down
captions: An engineer notices that the discount logic is copied in three places. She adds one line to the team's debt register. Nothing is fixed yet.
The team measures the interest. Each offer change takes 3 days instead of 1. The code changed 40 times last year and caused 2 incidents. It is a hotspot.
The team compares the item with planned features. Eight offer changes are coming, so the cleanup pays back soon. The PM agrees to 2 days of cleanup per sprint.
The debt is paid in small steps that each ship alone. First tests, then one shared module, then deleting the old copies. Features keep shipping.
The team measures again. Offer changes now take 1 day, and there are no pricing incidents. The register item is closed.
